style.backgroundSystem: alternating full-bleed blush-pink color bands and large rounded-corner white cards floating on a fine-texture light grey backdrop #E2E2E5

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of blush pink #F6DFDA, fine-texture light grey #E2E2E5, pure white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one coral red accent #E2492F; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with subtle serif English micro-labels; alternating full-bleed color bands and large rounded-corner white cards on a fine-texture grey backdrop; bright soft diffused studio lighting from the front-left with soft contact shadows; consistent thin-line icons inside thin coral-red circles; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
